review_candidates.title: Senior IT Specialist, Customer Support
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Role The Senior IT Specialist, Customer Support (Tier III) is responsible for designing and integrating systems within customer environments, supporting complex software and hardware issues, and ensuring successful implementation of Safe Fleet Video Group solutions. This role involves troubleshooting advanced technical problems, performing software installations, upgrades, and migrations, and working closely with customer IT teams to ensure seamless operation within complex infrastructures.
eligibility_evidence: At Safe Fleet, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Maintain advanced functional expertise in Safe Fleet Video Group products and technologies. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in a software/hardware support environment. Strong proficiency with Linux operating systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu), including command-line usage. Hands-on experience with database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Preferred Qualifications Experience with PowerShell scripting.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer

Monitor network health, set up alerts, and proactively troubleshoot latency or connectivity issues. Maintain accurate network diagrams and documentation for compliance and operational efficiency
eligibility_evidence: Be part of an experienced, international team.
